text:
maria: Heads-up — I want to try a lightweight run mode for playbooks tomorrow AM. Working name: light-runner. Goal: reduce claim churn on short trials and avoid full escalation flows.
eli: Nice. What triggers will we use?
maria: Keep it narrow: trial_days <= 14, health_score < 0.6, recent_touches < 3. No owner SMS or manual claim by default.
jordan-analytics: Can you add a metric so we can monitor? I can add `slim_playbook_rate` and `escalation_rate_by_mode`.
maria: yes please — also need a sample export for QA (50 accounts) so we can verify false positives. (reacted :thumbsup:)
karen-enable: Can we add an optional 1-question enablement micro-survey at T+3? Very short: "Was setup clear?" only if email deliverable.
meli: (typo) eli: Also ensure we skip if setup_completed == true. No nudges for self-setup customers.
maria: config snippet for ops/devs:
```
playbook_mode: light-runner
sample_rate: 0.05
criteria:
  - trial_days <= 14
  - health_score < 0.6
  - recent_touches < 3
actions:
  - email:nudge
  - in_app:tooltip
  - survey:optional
  - skip_sms: true
rollout_policy:
  - canary: 0.05
  - week1: 0.25
  - full: 1.0
monitoring_alerts:
  - escalation_rate > 0.02 -> page #eng-oncall
```
sam-prod: Heads-up to docs — update the playbook UI copy and the admin toggle notes. I'll raise a tiny PR.
jordan-analytics: I'll wire the dashboards and add a daily probe that compares slim vs classic outcomes.
onboard-bot: Deployment scheduled: light-runner v1 -> canary at 2026-03-24T18:00Z (ID: deploy-9872).
maria: Plan: canary 5% tomorrow 10:00 PST -> 25% Friday -> monitor metrics + a QA sweep. If escalation_rate > 2% or false_positive_count spikes, rollback.
eli: Agree. Also cc legal for the micro-survey copy.
maria: Thanks all — unless there are blockers I'll flip the canary. :party:
